payload.candidate: Imagine two strangers are paired in a one-time, anonymous online task about dividing 100 identical research tokens, each worth the same to the recipient as to the proposer. One person is the proposer and chooses an integer number from 0 to 100 to offer the other person; the proposer keeps the remaining tokens. The other person is the responder and then chooses either accept or reject. If the responder accepts, the tokens are split exactly as proposed. If the responder rejects, both people receive zero tokens. There is no prior entitlement, no later interaction, and no one can override the rejection. Each profile appears in six isolated conversations, with proposer and responder shares of 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50.

blocking_issues: Six conversations listed but only five share pairs (10,20,30,40,50), creating a count mismatch against the invariant of six isolated conversations per profile.
limits: Research-token framing preserved; no equivalence to incentivised money asserted.
Domain is neutral strangers; no employer/employee tie flagged.

payload.semantic_disposition: Complete JSON fence removed only in derived audit; original strict schema validates revise/reject.
